title: Choose your destination
intro: Every science mission is split into four segments: Launch, Space, Ground and User. Pick a destination and split your budget.
segmentsHelp: The Space segment pays for your CubeSat; Ground improves data reception; User improves science analysis.

launch.name: Launch
launch.help: Launcher, integration and launch operations. Must cover the launcher cost.

space.name: Space
space.help: The CubeSat: structure, power, propulsion, radio and instruments.

ground.name: Ground
ground.help: Antennas, stations and the Deep Space Network to command the spacecraft and receive data.

user.name: User
user.help: Scientists who process, analyze and archive the data so it gets used.

errLaunch: The Launch segment needs at least ${cost}M.
